2610.06582.title: Mind the Execution Gap: Action-Semantic Mismatch in World-Model Control
2610.06582.paper_summary: World-model controllers rely on action-conditioned dynamics for prediction and planning, yet real control systems often execute commands asynchronously due to communication delay, packet loss, reordering, and actuator buffering. We study how asynchronous execution changes the action semantics assumed within world-model controllers, rather than treating it only as an external control disturbance. Through controlled interventions, we identify two architecture-dependent failure modes: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC2 suffer from a future-action timeline mismatch between imagined and executed action sequences, while recurrent world models such as DreamerV3 can attribute observed transitions to commands that were not actually applied. Our analysis shows that TD-MPC2 requires the correct future action sequence during latent dynamics rollout, whereas DreamerV3 requires timely attribution of each transition to the action that generated it. Based on these findings, we introduce two lightweight execution-consistent interfaces, Future-Sequence for TD-MPC2 and Applied-Action Feedback for DreamerV3, that correct these mismatches without modifying the pretrained world models. Experiments across delays, packet loss, reordering, multiple control domains, measured network traces, and a process-separated asynchronous stack consistently support both diagnoses and the corresponding architecture-specific corrections.
2610.06582.paper_summary_zh: 世界模型控制器依賴於基於行動的動態進行預測和規劃，然而實際的控制系統往往因為通信延遲、數據包丟失、重排序和執行器緩衝而異步執行命令。<lb/>我們研究異步執行如何改變世界模型控制器中假設的行動語義，而不是僅僅將其視為外部控制擾動。<lb/>通過控制干預，我們確定了兩種依賴於架構的失效模式：基於規劃的控制器如TD-MPC2遭受想像和執行的行動序列之間的未來行動時間線不匹配，而循環世界模型如DreamerV3則可以將觀察到的轉變歸因於實際上並未應用的命令。<lb/>我們的分析顯示，TD-MPC2在潛在動態展開期間需要正確的未來行動序列，而DreamerV3則需要及時將每個轉變歸因於產生它的行動。<lb/>基於這些發現，我們引入了兩個輕量級的執行一致性介面，TD-MPC2的Future-Sequence和DreamerV3的Applied-Action Feedback，這些介面在不修改預訓練世界模型的情況下修正了這些不匹配。<lb/>在延遲、數據包丟失、重排序、多個控制領域、測量的網絡痕跡以及過程分離的異步堆棧中的實驗一致支持這兩種診斷及相應的架構特定修正。
